name: lastmile
description: Route optimization for AI agents on the Route Optimization service: onboard a customer's data, turn their rules into approved profile changes, solve, explain and deliver routes.

interface.longDescription: Drive the Route Optimization service from your agent: import and map a customer's data, interview them for the rules they forget to mention, send each rule change to an operator for approval, solve, explain why each job landed where it did, and deliver the routes only when the operator confirms. Access is invite-only.
